bracket: [Textbook misprint — this question has TWO correct options as printed, and is therefore withheld rather than keyed. Two of its alternatives, "no change" and "remains same", state the same thing in different words, and both are right: the frequency of a wave is fixed by its source and does not change when the wave crosses into another medium (only the speed and the wavelength change). A student choosing the second would be marked wrong for giving a correct answer, and every available repair invents an option the book never printed. Note this defect is invisible to an automatic duplicate-option check, because the two strings differ.]
